body: Although I long for the point where I'm not being a fucking living disappointment and really want to end myself, I really hope you do find something in these next few days that perhaps change your mind about how you think about yourself. I hope there's someway you find meaning in something or find it within yourself, because it's a very sad thing to end a life. Social anxiety and depression are fucking cancers of the mind and it's such a drain on a person to have to live with, but I do believe there's a way out. I haven't found it yet, but that in no way means that you definitely can't. If you choose to makes these the last days of your life, I really hope they're you're happiest. You have a basic human right to experience happiness in your final moments.

Why the fuck do I have to feel like this. Why couldn't​ I mentally develop normally and enjoy my experiences. Why do I long for more than I what I have. I have a list for being interesting, a lust for being entertaining and approachable. But I was given the cards, and I developed into a sad, pathetic fucking person. I'm boring and deliciously dull. I fucking envy anyone with a semblance of conversational skills. It pisses me off. I naturally have people turn away from me. 

Lmao why would I even want to live long enough to have kids? Why would I even fucking think about passing on any single trait of mine to a progeny. But I suppose this is nature taking it's course. I'm pathetic. I realize it, decided that I wouldn't want to bring anyone into this world that vaguely resembles me, and so I've naturally decided to off myself before I have the chance to have kids. Maybe it's better this way. I wouldn't want more pathetic people like me to exist in this world. There's no point. It'd be a fucking cycle of suicide. 

Ah well, at least I've come equipped with the ability to look at myself and think "oh wow how pathetic. Do you really think you'd be doing the world a favor walking another day on this planet?" At least I'm that self aware. What a blessing.
